test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If at the same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is 40 and compound interest, compounded annually, is 42, then what is the principal (in)?
solution:
**Given:**

SI = 40

CI = 42

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

CI - SI = P(dfrac{r}{100})²

SI = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

**Calculation:**

CI - SI = 42 - 40 = 2

⇒ P(dfrac{r}{100})² = 2 …(1)

SI = 40 ⇒ dfrac{P times r times 2}{100} = 40

⇒ dfrac{P times r}{100} = 20 …(2)

From (2): P × r = 2000

From (1): P × r² = 20000

⇒ (P × r²) ÷ (P × r) = 20000 ÷ 2000 = 10

⇒ r = 10%

Now, P × r / 100 = 20

⇒ P × 10 / 100 = 20

⇒ P = 200

**∴ Principal = ₹200**
